blocks.content: Balancing consumer interests with telecom profitability.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Rapid technological shifts like 5G and internet telephony require continuous regulatory adaptation.
TRAI must strike a delicate balance between safeguarding consumer interests and ensuring financial profitability for telecom companies.
The regulation of Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms is an emerging challenge for TRAI.

blocks.content: • Balancing consumer interests with telecom profitability.

items: Identify 5G and internet telephony as primary technological disruption challenges for TRAI.
